sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Neuralgia (first right, then left side), with
veil before eyes. Confusion, with dimness of vision.
Much sneezing, with fluent coryza. Bleeding from nose.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Sensation as of gauze before eyes. [Calc.;
Caust; Nat. m.] Binocular vision imperfect.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Intense sore feeling about uterus; bearing-
down, with hot sweat, but without relief. Much slimy
leucorrhoea when walking. [Bov.; Carb. an.; Graph.]
Soreness and redness of external genitals. [Thuj.;
Sulpk.] Pelvic inflammation, tympanites, abdominal
tenderness and hot sweat which does not relieve.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Urticaria. Violent itching, and burning like
fire after scratching. Eruption of small, red itching
pimples. Sweat warm and profuse soon after falling
asleep. Sweat increases as rheumatic pains increase.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, in afternoon and evening ; in
warm room, heat of bed. Better, cool room, motion.
